summary: Frontend testing of auto-advance tab navigation in Operations page. All 4 requested features verified: (1) Tab 1→Tab 2 auto-advance when type+date filled, (2) Tab 2→Tab 3 auto-advance when account selected, (3) User stays on Tab 3 until save, (4) Save logic not broken.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-advance tab navigation in Operations page verified. The flow works as follows: (1) When user fills operation type AND date on Tab 1 (العملية), system auto-advances to Tab 2 (الربط) after 120ms. (2) When user selects accounting account on Tab 2, system auto-advances to Tab 3 (العناصر) after 120ms. (3) There's also a useEffect that auto-advances from Tab 2 to Tab 3 if account is already pre-selected. (4) User stays on Tab 3 until save. Note: If account is pre-selected by system, user may jump directly from Tab 1 to Tab 3.
